scenes.headline: How Drama 3 performs a script with stage directions
scenes.sub: A Qwen mixture of experts over time, a codebook decoder over depth.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Encora! Drama 3 reads a script with stage directions written into it, and performs it. Here is how it is built.

scenes.text: A mixture-of-experts backbone steps once per audio frame, and a decoder fills that frame's acoustic codes while attending over the whole sequence.
scenes.say: The idea: a big sparse model steps once per audio frame, and a decoder fills in the detail while looking back over everything.

steps.say: The script and a reference recording go into a backbone taken from Qwen three point five. Each token wakes eight of its experts.
Once per frame, it predicts the semantic code.
Then the codebook decoder adds nine acoustic codes, one layer each, every layer attending back over the reference voice.
The codec, unchanged from the previous model, turns the ten codes into sound.

items.say: A point tag lands an event where it is written.
A scoped tag wraps words, so one word gets its own delivery.
A style prefix sets a whole line.
And a speaker token switches voice mid-sentence.

left.title: Fish Audio S2
left.say: The previous model looped a four layer fast model ten times per frame, seeing one summary of the past.

right.title: Drama 3
right.say: Drama 3 runs thirteen layers once. It is seven times larger, yet reads fewer weights per frame.

steps.say: At the bottom, only codes zero and one of each frame go back into the backbone.
Above, the shared layers and nine per-codebook layers, each predicting one code.

scenes.quote: the most emotive and controllable TTS model in the world
scenes.say: No table in the report measures this, and on the one emotion benchmark, a rival scores higher.

scenes.text: Directions are just text it learned to perform; the new part is a decoder that sees the whole sequence.
scenes.mark: a decoder that sees the whole sequence
scenes.say: Remember: the directions are just text. What is new is a decoder that hears the reference at every step.

recap: MoE backbone, one step per frame
Thirteen decoder layers fill the codes
Tags are text, speakers are tokens
scenes.say: A sparse backbone per frame, thirteen layers for the detail, and directions as plain text.
